parameters.help_en:
The status of the user backup file. Valid values:
Importing: The backup is being imported.
Failed: The import failed.
CheckSuccess: The verification passed.
BackupSuccess: The import succeeded.
Deleted: The backup is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
通过用户备份文件的状态查询目标用户备份。取值：
Importing：导入中。
Failed：导入失败。
CheckSuccess：校验通过。
BackupSuccess：导入成功。
Deleted：已删除

Records.description_en: The list of user backup file details
Records.description_zh: 用户备份文件详情列表

items.description_en: The details of a user backup file

BinlogInfo.description_en: The binary log file information in the backup file. This parameter is returned if incremental data exists during the backup process
BinlogInfo.description_zh: 备份文件中的Binlog文件信息，备份过程中如有增量内容则会返回此参数

Comment.description_en: The comment of the user backup

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the user backup import started. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
CreationTime.description_zh: 用户备份的导入开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳。单位：毫秒

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the user backup was successfully imported. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
FinishTime.description_zh: 用户备份成功导入的时间，格式为Unix时间戳。单位：毫秒

ModificationTime.description_en: The time when the user backup import was completed. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
ModificationTime.description_zh: 用户备份的导入完成时间，格式为Unix时间戳。单位：毫秒

OssBucket.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket in which the user backup file is stored
OssBucket.description_zh: 用户备份文件所在的OSS Bucket名称

OssFileMetaData.description_en: The metadata of the user backup file. For more information, see [Manage object metadata]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31859.html）
OssFileMetaData.description_zh: 用户备份文件元信息。更多信息，请参见[管理文件元信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31859.html）

OssFileName.description_en: The name of the user backup file in OSS
OssFileName.description_zh: OSS中用户备份文件的文件名

OssFilePath.description_en: The path of the user backup file in OSS
OssFilePath.description_zh: OSS中用户备份文件的路径

OssFileSize.description_en: The size of the user backup file in OSS. Unit: KB
OssFileSize.description_zh: OSS中用户备份文件的大小。单位：KB

OssUrl.description_en: The OSS download URL of the user backup file
OssUrl.description_zh: 用户备份文件的OSS下载地址

Reason.description_en: The reason why the user backup file failed to be imported
Reason.description_zh: 用户备份文件导入失败的原因

RestoreSize.description_en: The storage space required to restore the user backup. Unit: GB
RestoreSize.description_zh: 还原用户备份所需存储空间大小。单位：GB

Retention.description_en: The retention period of the user backup file. Unit: days
Retention.description_zh: 用户备份文件保留时长。单位：天

Status.description_en:
The status of the user backup file. Valid values:
Importing: The backup is being imported.
Failed: The import failed.
CheckSuccess: The verification passed.

Deleted: The backup is deleted

用户备份文件状态。返回值：

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the user backup
ZoneId.description_zh: 用户备份所在的可用区ID
